sources.excerpt: Your Face 70's — Wren and Cuff Home Pedals All Pedals Muffs Distortion/Fuzz Boost and Compression Info Shipping Warranty Repairs Artists About Us FAQ's Gift Cards Apparel Dealers Contact B-Stock Home Pedals All Pedals Muffs Distortion/Fuzz Boost and Compression Info Shipping Warranty Repairs Artists About Us FAQ's Gift Cards Apparel Dealers Contact B-Stock Pedals All Hidden Newsletter ← Back to Pedals Your Face 70's Your Face 70's $189.99 70'S SILICON THAT'S SMOOTH AS F**K Hand matched NOS BC108C Transistors True hard-wire bypass 9V battery or 2.1mm adapter Made in the USA Lifetime warranty Quantity: Add To Cart With the edge of a tight silicon fuzz, and some custom filtering to warm it all up, The Your Face 70's is all that's loved about the 70's Fuzz Faces, with some added tweaks to smooth things over. We take two hand-matched BC108 silicon transistors selected for specific gains, super-quiet metal film resistors, and add smoothing capacitors to tame spiky highs and eliminate squealing at higher volumes, and that's only the start. Don't like the low output on a traditional FF? Fixed it. All the volume you could ever want or need. Don't like the way that a traditional FF fuzz knob is only useful at the last end of the knob? We've added a reverse-log potentiometer that widens that range and let's you dial things in just right. Mullard “tropical fish” out-cap with increased value to allow more lows to come through. Also, Mullard tropical fish caps just look damn cool. Custom “You” knob functions as a low-cut to reduce some of the low-end squash, letting you dial things in just right for "you". This is a simple but fantastic mod that gives an incredible amount of versatility. I've seen this mod alone turn FF haters into instant fans. Truly an ultra-smooth high-gain silicon 70’s style fuzzer with all the right tweaks. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Wren And Cuff Your Face 70's Back to results Wren And Cuff Your Face 70's Fuzz 1970s Fuzz Face recreation with silicon transistors. Brighter, more aggressive fuzz. 1970s silicon Fuzz Face variant built around two hand-matched NOS BC108C silicon transistors selected for specific gain characteristics. Super-quiet metal film resistors, smoothing capacitors to tame spiky highs and eliminate squealing, Mullard tropical fish output capacitor with increased value for more low-end. Fuzz control uses a reverse-log potentiometer that fixes the common Fuzz Face problem of the knob only being useful in the last portion of its rotation, spreading usable range across the full sweep. The You knob replaces the standard volume control with a custom low-cut filter to reduce low-end squash. Higher output than traditional Fuzz Face designs. The circuit tweaks address classic Fuzz Face complaints: squealing, limited knob range, and boomy low end. Silicon transistors, not germanium—the germanium version is the Your Face 60's. True hard-wire bypass, 5mA draw, 4.8 x 2.6 x 1.6 inches, 9.5 oz.
